purpose: List every GW001 playoff Result with matching Match Report by fixture ID and expose key/division/stage differences
sql: SELECT r.sm_fixture_id,r.match_date,r.home_name,r.away_name,r.home_score,r.away_score,r.competition_key result_key,r.sm_division result_division,r.competition_stage result_stage,m.sm_fixture_id report_fixture_id,m.competition_key report_key,m.sm_division report_division,m.competition_stage report_stage,m.home_name report_home,m.away_name report_away,m.home_score report_home_score,m.away_score report_away_score FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.competition_key LIKE 'GW001|DOMESTIC|playoff%' OR m.competition_key LIKE 'GW001|DOMESTIC|playoff%' ORDER BY r.match_date,r.sm_fixture_id
